description: This file defines an API client for DeepEval, including URL constants, an enum for HTTP methods, an enum for API endpoints, and an Api class with methods for making synchronous and asynchronous POST requests to the DeepEval API.

classes.name: HttpMethods
classes.description: Enumeration of HTTP methods supported by the API client.

classes.name: Endpoints
classes.description: Enumeration of API endpoint paths used in the DeepEval API.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the DeepEval API, supporting both sync and async POST requests.

methods.name: log_retry_error
methods.description: Logs retry errors with details about the exception and number of tries.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Api class with API key and optional base URL, sets up HTTP handlers.

methods.name: _http_request
methods.description: Performs a POST HTTP request using the sync handler, raises exceptions on errors.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: Sends a synchronous API request with specified method, endpoint, and body.

methods.name: a_send_request
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous API request with specified method, endpoint, and body.
